The batch size decreases by one every four iterations. X axis refers to iteration. Each iteration represents the generation of one token across N candidates in parallel. Y axis refers to the generation speed (tokens/s). All model parameters are resident in memory.
blocks.translation: 图 13：Best-of-N（N=4）设置下，PowerInfer-2、QNN 和 PowerInfer-2-CPUOnly 在 Bamboo-7B 上的解码速度曲线。每四次迭代，批量大小减少 1。横轴为迭代次数，每次迭代代表对 N 个候选并行生成一个 token；纵轴为生成速度，单位 tokens/s。所有模型参数均驻留内存。

blocks.original_text: 7.5 Performance Breakdown
blocks.translation: 7.5 性能分解

blocks.original_text: To quantify each optimization’s contribution, we conducted an ablation study by incrementally enabling optimizations. Starting from a baseline configuration, we progressively added Bundle, Neuron Cache, Neuron-Cluster-Level Pipeline, and XPU optimizations. Fig.14 shows the performance impact of each addition.
blocks.translation: 为量化各项优化的贡献，我们通过逐步启用优化开展消融研究。从基线配置开始，依次加入捆绑（Bundle）、神经元缓存（Neuron Cache）、神经元簇级流水线（Neuron-Cluster-Level Pipeline）及 XPU 优化。图 14 展示了每项新增优化的性能影响。

blocks.original_text: Figure 14: Performance breakdown for decoding phase of the Bamboo-7B model on OnePlus 12, with 50% FFN weights offloaded to flash storage.
blocks.translation: 图 14：OnePlus 12 上，Bamboo-7B 在卸载 50% FFN 权重时，解码阶段的性能分解。

blocks.original_text: The baseline system utilizes CPU without any optimizations and achieves 0.4 tokens/s without optimizations. Adding Bundle optimization improves this to 1.1 tokens/s by increasing I/O efficiency through bundled memory access operations. Neuron Cache further brings a 2.82× speedup (4.181 tokens/s) by achieving a 95% cache hit rate, significantly reducing Flash I/O bandwidth pressure. Pipeline optimization adds another 1.29× improvement (9.60 tokens/s) through overlapped computation and memory access. Finally, XPU optimization provides an additional 15% gain (11.07 tokens/s) by utilizing both CPU and XPU for concurrent memory access.
blocks.translation: 基线系统仅使用 CPU，不采用任何优化，速度为 0.4 tokens/s。加入 Bundle 优化后，通过捆绑内存访问提高 I/O 效率，速度提高到 1.1 tokens/s。Neuron Cache 达到 95% 的缓存命中率，显著减轻闪存 I/O 带宽压力，进一步带来 2.82 倍加速，速度达到 4.181 tokens/s。Pipeline 通过重叠计算与内存访问，再带来 1.29 倍提升，达到 9.60 tokens/s。最后，XPU 优化利用 CPU 与 XPU 并发访问内存，额外提升 15%，达到 11.07 tokens/s。

blocks.original_text: 7.6 Accuracy Evaluation
blocks.translation: 7.6 准确率评估

blocks.original_text: We evaluate inference accuracy using OpenCompass [19], a widely-adopted benchmark suite, focusing on INT4 quantization which is the de facto standard in real-world mobile deployments [38, 56]. As shown in Table 7, PowerInfer-2 maintains comparable accuracy to llama.cpp across different models and tasks, while significantly outperforming QNN. The accuracy gap between frameworks stems from their different quantization approaches. QNN uses per-channel quantization (one scale per weight matrix row), which poorly handles weights with outlier values. llama.cpp achieves better accuracy by quantizing weights in groups of 32. Since NPUs don’t support group-wise quantization, PowerInfer-2 adopts a hybrid quantization approach that handles outlier weights in INT8 precision while applying INT4 per-channel quantization to remaining weights, effectively preserving accuracy while maintaining fast inference speed similar to QNN.
blocks.translation: 我们使用广泛采用的 OpenCompass [19] 基准套件评估推理准确率，重点关注 INT4 量化，因为它已成为真实移动部署中的事实标准 [38,56]。如表 7 所示，PowerInfer-2 在不同模型和任务上的准确率与 llama.cpp 相近，并显著优于 QNN。框架间的准确率差异源于量化方法不同：QNN 使用逐通道量化，即每个权重矩阵行对应一个缩放因子，难以处理带离群值的权重；llama.cpp 则将权重按每组 32 个进行量化，从而获得更好的准确率。由于 NPU 不支持分组量化，PowerInfer-2 采用混合量化：以 INT8 精度处理离群权重，其余权重使用 INT4 逐通道量化，在有效保持准确率的同时，实现接近 QNN 的快速推理。

blocks.translation: 表 7：Bamboo 7B 和 Qwen2 7B 使用不同量化方法时的 LLM 准确率比较。评估包括 Arc Challenge [16]、Arc Easy、MMLU [25] 和 GSM8K [17] 基准。

blocks.original_text: 7.7 Energy Consumption
blocks.translation: 7.7 能耗

blocks.original_text: We evaluate the energy efficiency of PowerInfer-2 through evaluation of end-to-end energy consumption during inference. Our primary metric is Joules per token (J/token), which quantifies the average energy required to generate each output token. To ensure representative results, we randomly sampled 100 prompts from the lmsys/lmsys-chat-1m [63] dataset, which contains real-world user interactions collected from chatbot deployments. The mean energy consumption results are shown in Table 8. PowerInfer-2 demonstrates superior energy efficiency, achieving 0.257 J/token, which represents a 31.1% and 61.8% reduction in energy consumption compared to QNN and llama.cpp, respectively. This enhanced efficiency is attributed to PowerInfer-2’s ability to maintain similar peak power while achieving faster computation speeds, resulting in lower overall energy consumption.
blocks.translation: 我们通过测量推理期间的端到端能耗，评估 PowerInfer-2 的能效。主要指标为每 token 焦耳数（J/token），用于量化生成每个输出 token 所需的平均能量。为保证结果具有代表性，我们从 lmsys/lmsys-chat-1m [63] 数据集中随机抽取 100 个提示词；该数据集包含从聊天机器人部署中收集的真实用户交互。平均能耗结果见表 8。PowerInfer-2 具有更好的能效，每 token 耗能为 0.257 J，相对 QNN 和 llama.cpp 分别降低 31.1% 和 61.8%。这一能效提升来自 PowerInfer-2 能够在峰值功率相近的情况下提高计算速度，从而降低整体能耗。

blocks.original_text: 8 Related Work
blocks.translation: 8 相关工作

blocks.original_text: Resource-Efficient DNN/LLM Inference. The deployment of DNNs and LLMs on resource-constrained devices has gained significant traction recently [58]. While BAND [28] demonstrates the feasibility of running multiple compact DNNs on a single XPU, its methodology does not address the memory-flash hierarchy and cannot scale to accommodate LLMs due to their substantial computational demands. MLC-LLM [53] represents a significant advancement in enabling GPU-accelerated LLM deployment on mobile devices. Nevertheless, it is constrained by the requirement that models must fit entirely in memory. Although mllm-NPU [57] leverages on-device NPU, it lacks CPU-NPU co-processing and requires models to fit in memory, limiting its use for larger models. While STI [23] introduces pipeline mechanisms for I/O-compute overlapping, its capability is limited to BERT-scale models (0.33B parameters) on embedded devices, making it insufficient for modern LLMs that typically exceed 1B parameters. Various model compression techniques have emerged, including network pruning [27,40], knowledge distillation [29], and quantization [13,36], all aimed at reducing model memory footprints. These approaches complement PowerInfer-2 and can be integrated with it to further enhance the efficiency of LLM deployment on mobile devices.
blocks.translation: 资源高效的 DNN/LLM 推理。近期，在资源受限设备上部署 DNN 与 LLM 受到广泛关注 [58]。BAND [28] 展示了在单个 XPU 上运行多个紧凑型 DNN 的可行性，但其方法没有处理内存–闪存层次结构，且由于 LLM 具有较大的计算需求，无法扩展到 LLM。MLC-LLM [53] 推动了移动设备上的 GPU 加速 LLM 部署，但要求模型必须完整装入内存。mllm-NPU [57] 虽然利用端侧 NPU，却缺少 CPU–NPU 协同处理，同样要求模型装入内存，因此难以用于更大模型。STI [23] 引入了 I/O 与计算重叠的流水线机制，但仅支持嵌入式设备上的 BERT 规模模型，即 0.33B 参数，不足以支持通常超过 1B 参数的现代 LLM。此外，网络剪枝 [27,40]、知识蒸馏 [29] 和量化 [13,36] 等模型压缩方法，均旨在减少模型内存占用。它们与 PowerInfer-2 互补，可以结合使用，进一步提高移动端 LLM 部署效率。

blocks.original_text: Speculative Decoding. Speculative decoding accelerates inference by leveraging a smaller model to predict tokens in parallel [12,20,33]. The technique employs a smaller model (e.g., 1B) to generate candidate tokens, which are then validated in batch by a larger model (e.g., 13B). SpecInfer [41] demonstrates that this approach effectively reduces decoding iterations. While speculative decoding and sparse activation are orthogonal optimization strategies, their integration in memory-constrained XPU environments remains an open research challenge.
blocks.translation: 推测解码。推测解码利用较小模型并行预测 token，以加速推理 [12,20,33]。该技术先使用小模型，例如 1B 模型，生成候选 token，再交由大模型，例如 13B 模型，批量验证。SpecInfer [41] 表明，该方法能够有效减少解码迭代次数。虽然推测解码与稀疏激活是相互正交的优化策略，但如何在内存受限的 XPU 环境中整合二者，仍是开放的研究挑战。

blocks.original_text: 9 Conclusion
blocks.translation: 9 结论

blocks.original_text: This paper presents PowerInfer-2, a mobile-centric LLM inference framework that effectively runs LLMs on smartphones with limited memory. Evaluation demonstrates that PowerInfer-2 achieves up to 27.8× speedup over existing solutions while supporting models as large as 47B with minimal accuracy loss.
blocks.translation: 本文提出 PowerInfer-2，这是一种以移动端为中心的 LLM 推理框架，能够在内存有限的智能手机上有效运行 LLM。评估表明，PowerInfer-2 相对现有方案最高实现 27.8 倍加速，同时支持规模达 47B 的模型，且准确率损失很小。

figures.original_caption: Figure 1: Comparison of sampling strategies used in LLM inference. (a) Basic sampling generates a single response directly from the prompt. figures.translation: 图 1：LLM 推理中采样策略的比较。（a）基本采样直接根据提示词生成单个回答。（b）Best-of-N 采样为一个提示词生成多个候选回答序列，再通过排序过程选择最终回答。

figures.original_caption: Figure 2: Neuron activation patterns in layer 10 of Bamboo-7B under different batch sizes. The X-axis represents the proportion of neurons (sorted by activation frequency), and the Y-axis shows different batch sizes. Darker red indicates lower activation frequency.
figures.translation: 图 2：不同批量大小下，Bamboo-7B 第 10 层的神经元激活模式。横轴为神经元比例，神经元按激活频率排序；纵轴为不同批量大小。红色越深，表示激活频率越低。

figures.original_caption: Figure 3: (a) Comparison of execution times for matrix-vector multiplication operations with varying computational loads across CPU, GPU, and NPU platforms. The test involves multiplying a $14336\times4096$ matrix with vectors under different batch sizes. The X-axis represents the batch size while the Y-axis shows execution time. (b) Random read throughput performance for 4KB operations across different block sizes and data ranges. The X-axis depicts block size, while the Y-axis represents throughput.
figures.translation: 图 3：（a）CPU、GPU 和 NPU 平台在不同计算负载下执行矩阵–向量乘法的时间比较。测试在不同批量大小下，将 $14336\times4096$ 矩阵与向量相乘。横轴为批量大小，纵轴为执行时间。（b）不同块大小和数据范围下，4KB 操作的随机读取吞吐表现。横轴为块大小，纵轴为吞吐量。

figures.original_caption: Figure 4: The architecture overview of PowerInfer-2.

Figure 5: Two computing workflows for prefill and decoding phases. (a) The prefill phase uses an NPU-centric workflow that leverages NPU for computation; (b) The decoding phase employs a CPU-NPU hybrid workflow for FFN computation where NPU handles dense computations for hot neurons while CPU cores process sparse computations for cold neurons, with their processing ratio automatically adjusting to match the dynamic sparsity patterns caused by varying batch sizes. The attention computation is handled entirely by NPU but not shown in the figure.
figures.translation: 图 5：预填充和解码阶段的两种计算流程。（a）预填充阶段采用以 NPU 为中心的流程，利用 NPU 执行计算。（b）解码阶段的 FFN 计算采用 CPU–NPU 混合流程：NPU 对热神经元执行稠密计算，CPU 核心对冷神经元执行稀疏计算；处理比例自动调整，以适应批量大小变化引起的动态稀疏模式。注意力计算全部由 NPU 处理，未在图中显示。

figures.original_caption: Figure 6: Two types of pipelines that combine matrix-vector multiplications and I/O operations on five cores (4 calculation cores and 1 I/O cores). Assuming that there are 8 neuron cluster per matrix, 4 of them are in memory and the other 4 are in flash before the computation starts. (a) The matrix-level pipeline separates the pipeline into isolated matrix units; (b) The neuron-cluster-level pipeline in PowerInfer-2 breaks the matrix barrier and mixs their calculation and I/O operations in the neuron cluster granularity.
figures.translation: 图 6：在五个核心上组合矩阵–向量乘法与 I/O 操作的两类流水线，其中包含 4 个计算核心和 1 个 I/O 核心。假设每个矩阵有 8 个神经元簇，计算开始前，4 个位于内存，另 4 个位于闪存。（a）矩阵级流水线将执行过程分为彼此隔离的矩阵单元。（b）PowerInfer-2 的神经元簇级流水线打破矩阵间屏障，在神经元簇粒度混合安排计算与 I/O。

notes.original_text: 2Qualcomm’s NPUs typically employ coarse-grained per-channel quantization that leads to accuracy degradation. This issue can be fixed by adopting a mixed-precision quantization approach inspired by AWQ [15,36], which preserves outlier weights while applying INT4 quantization to the remaining components, effectively maintaining model accuracy.
notes.translation: 脚注 2：高通 NPU 通常采用粗粒度逐通道量化，会导致准确率下降。受 AWQ [15,36] 启发，采用混合精度量化可修复这一问题：保留离群权重，对其余部分使用 INT4 量化，从而有效维持模型准确率。
